sys_hub_flow.description:
Wrapper subflow for creating a completion for the chat message

Inputs:

  • Deployment ID - String - The name of your model deployment. You're required to first deploy a model before you can make calls.
  • Transaction ID - String - The Transaction ID.
  • Messages - JSON - Message objects where each message has a role and content - content can be a string or an array of typed blocks (text or image_url), e.g. [{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"describe the image"},{"type":"image_url","image_url":{"url":"sys_id of the image"}}]}]."
  • Max Tokens - Integer - The maximum number of tokens to generate in the completion.
  • Temperature - Float - The sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic.
  • Top P - Float - An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.
  • N - Integer - How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.
  • Stop - Array - Up to 4 sequences where the API will stop generating further tokens.
  • Presence Penalty - Float - Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.
  • Frequency Penalty - Float - Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.
  • Logit Bias - JSON - Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.
  • User - String - A unique identifier representing your end-user, which can help OpenAI to monitor and detect abuse.

Outputs:

  • Action Status - Object
    • Code - Integer - Returns 0 if success and error code if failure occurs.
    • Message - String - 'Success' if the whole request succeeds or respective error message if a failure occurs.
  • ID - String - Unique Id.
  • Object - String - Details of the API used for the request.
  • Created - Integer - Timestamp of the request.
  • Model - String - Details of the model used for the request.
  • Choices - Array of Objects - Contains the Completion chat messages for the given messages along with index & finish reason.
  • Usage - JSON - Count of Prompt Tokens, Completion Tokens & Total Tokens.

Error Codes - Error Messages:

  • 401 - Invalid Authentication
  • 401 - Incorrect API key provided
  • 401 - You must be a member of an organization to use the API
  • 429 - Rate limit reached for requests
  • 429 - You exceeded your current quota, please check your plan and billing details
  • 429 - The engine is currently overloaded, please try again later
  • 500 - The server had an error while processing your request

sys_hub_flow_snapshot.description:
Wrapper subflow for creating a completion for the chat message

Inputs:

  • Deployment ID - String - The name of your model deployment. You're required to first deploy a model before you can make calls.
  • Transaction ID - String - The Transaction ID.
  • Messages - JSON - Message objects where each message has a role and content - content can be a string or an array of typed blocks (text or image_url), e.g. [{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"describe the image"},{"type":"image_url","image_url":{"url":"sys_id of the image"}}]}]."
  • Max Tokens - Integer - The maximum number of tokens to generate in the completion.
  • Temperature - Float - The sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic.
  • Top P - Float - An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.
  • N - Integer - How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.
  • Stop - Array - Up to 4 sequences where the API will stop generating further tokens.
  • Presence Penalty - Float - Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.
  • Frequency Penalty - Float - Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.
  • Logit Bias - JSON - Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.
  • User - String - A unique identifier representing your end-user, which can help OpenAI to monitor and detect abuse.

Outputs:

  • Action Status - Object
    • Code - Integer - Returns 0 if success and error code if failure occurs.
    • Message - String - 'Success' if the whole request succeeds or respective error message if a failure occurs.
  • ID - String - Unique Id.
  • Object - String - Details of the API used for the request.
  • Created - Integer - Timestamp of the request.
  • Model - String - Details of the model used for the request.
  • Choices - Array of Objects - Contains the Completion chat messages for the given messages along with index & finish reason.
  • Usage - JSON - Count of Prompt Tokens, Completion Tokens & Total Tokens.

Error Codes - Error Messages:

  • 401 - Invalid Authentication
  • 401 - Incorrect API key provided
  • 401 - You must be a member of an organization to use the API
  • 429 - Rate limit reached for requests
  • 429 - You exceeded your current quota, please check your plan and billing details
  • 429 - The engine is currently overloaded, please try again later
  • 500 - The server had an error while processing your request

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_hub_flow"><sys_hub_flow action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><acls/><active>false</active><allow_high_security_roles>false</allow_high_security_roles><annotation/><attributes>browserActivatedIn=chrome,integrationActivatedIn=standalone,labelCacheCleanUpExecuted=true,timeFromCreateToActivate=52625277000,viewActivatedIn=naturalLanguage</attributes><authored_on_release_version/><callable_by_client_api>false</callable_by_client_api><category/><copied_from>eebde91f43213110fce343852db8f23c</copied_from><copied_from_name>Chat Completions - Wrapper</copied_from_name><description><p>Wrapper subflow for creating a completion for the chat message</p>
<p>
    <b>Inputs:</b>
</p>
<ul>
    <li>
        <strong>Deployment ID</strong> - String - The name of your model deployment. You're required to first deploy a
        model before you can make calls.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Transaction ID</strong> - String - The Transaction ID.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Messages</strong> - JSON - Message objects where each message has a role and content - content can be a string or an array of typed blocks (text or image_url), e.g. [{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"describe the image"},{"type":"image_url","image_url":{"url":"sys_id of the image"}}]}]."
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Max Tokens</strong> - Integer - The maximum number of tokens to generate in the completion.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Temperature</strong> - Float - The sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8
        will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Top P</strong> - Float - An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where
        the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens
        comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>N</strong> - Integer - How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Stop</strong> - Array - Up to 4 sequences where the API will stop generating further tokens.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Presence Penalty</strong> - Float - Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens
        based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Frequency Penalty</strong> - Float - Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens
        based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line
        verbatim.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Logit Bias</strong> - JSON - Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>User</strong> - String - A unique identifier representing your end-user, which can help OpenAI to
        monitor and detect abuse.
    </li>

</ul>
<p>
    <b>Outputs:</b>
</p>
<ul>
    <li>
        <strong>Action Status</strong> - Object
        <ul>
            <li>
                <strong>Code</strong> - Integer - Returns 0 if success and error code if failure occurs.
            </li>
            <li>
                <strong>Message</strong> - String - 'Success' if the whole request succeeds or respective error message
                if a failure occurs.
            </li>
        </ul>
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>ID</strong> - String - Unique Id.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Object</strong> - String - Details of the API used for the request.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Created</strong> - Integer - Timestamp of the request.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Model</strong> - String - Details of the model used for the request.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Choices</strong> - Array of Objects - Contains the Completion chat messages for the given messages along
        with index & finish reason.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Usage</strong> - JSON - Count of Prompt Tokens, Completion Tokens & Total Tokens.
    </li>
</ul>

<p>
    <b>Error Codes - Error Messages:</b>
</p>
<ul>
    <li>401 - Invalid Authentication</li>
    <li>401 - Incorrect API key provided</li>
    <li>401 - You must be a member of an organization to use the API</li>
    <li>429 - Rate limit reached for requests</li>
    <li>429 - You exceeded your current quota, please check your plan and billing details</li>
    <li>429 - The engine is currently overloaded, please try again later</li>
    <li>500 - The server had an error while processing your request</li>
</ul></description><display_name_after_preview/><flow_priority/><generation_source/><internal_name>chat_completions_wrapper_vision</internal_name><label_cache>[{"name":"subflow.request_metadata","label":"Input➛Request subflow for creating a completion for the chat message</p>
<p>
    <b>Inputs:</b>
</p>
<ul>
    <li>
        <strong>Deployment ID</strong> - String - The name of your model deployment. You're required to first deploy a
        model before you can make calls.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Transaction ID</strong> - String - The Transaction ID.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Messages</strong> - JSON - Message objects where each message has a role and content - content can be a string or an array of typed blocks (text or image_url), e.g. [{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"describe the image"},{"type":"image_url","image_url":{"url":"sys_id of the image"}}]}]."
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Max Tokens</strong> - Integer - The maximum number of tokens to generate in the completion.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Temperature</strong> - Float - The sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8
        will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Top P</strong> - Float - An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where
        the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens
        comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>N</strong> - Integer - How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Stop</strong> - Array - Up to 4 sequences where the API will stop generating further tokens.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Presence Penalty</strong> - Float - Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens
        based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Frequency Penalty</strong> - Float - Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens
        based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line
        verbatim.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Logit Bias</strong> - JSON - Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>User</strong> - String - A unique identifier representing your end-user, which can help OpenAI to
        monitor and detect abuse.
    </li>

</ul>
<p>
    <b>Outputs:</b>
</p>
<ul>
    <li>
        <strong>Action Status</strong> - Object
        <ul>
            <li>
                <strong>Code</strong> - Integer - Returns 0 if success and error code if failure occurs.
            </li>
            <li>
                <strong>Message</strong> - String - 'Success' if the whole request succeeds or respective error message
                if a failure occurs.
            </li>
        </ul>
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>ID</strong> - String - Unique Id.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Object</strong> - String - Details of the API used for the request.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Created</strong> - Integer - Timestamp of the request.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Model</strong> - String - Details of the model used for the request.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Choices</strong> - Array of Objects - Contains the Completion chat messages for the given messages along
        with index & finish reason.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Usage</strong> - JSON - Count of Prompt Tokens, Completion Tokens & Total Tokens.
    </li>
</ul>

<p>
    <b>Error Codes - Error Messages:</b>
</p>
<ul>
    <li>401 - Invalid Authentication</li>
    <li>401 - Incorrect API key provided</li>
    <li>401 - You must be a member of an organization to use the API</li>
    <li>429 - Rate limit reached for requests</li>
    <li>429 - You exceeded your current quota, please check your plan and billing details</li>
    <li>429 - The engine is currently overloaded, please try again later</li>
    <li>500 - The server had an error while processing your request</li>
</ul></description><flow_priority/><internal_name>chat_completions_wrapper_vision</internal_name><label_cache>[{"name":"subflow.request_metadata","label":"Input➛Request
